description: Aranayake Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Lanes 2nd Gazette.
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the official declaration of road ownership and maintenance responsibilities by the Aranayaka Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed land surveys, boundary coordinates, road dimensions, and property registrations for various roads and narrow roads in the Sabaragamuwa Province, making it clearly a Land Gazette under Type 4 classification.
